QuestInfo.name: Demon Rock 1
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Master Loong about Ravana and the Golden Temple. Sounds like the underground temple is much more dangerous than you thought.
QuestInfo.1: While you were talking to Master Loong about Ravana, a tremor came from the west. He said it felt like the #b#o8144006##k monsters waking up at #r#m252020500##k. Eliminate #b100#k before they bring the whole temple down.
QuestInfo.2: You crushed the #b#o8144006##k threat. Looks like there won't be any more earthquakes.

0.0: Or maybe the monkeys were always mischievous, and we just didn't notice until now... \r\n#L0##bHey, have you ever thought that maybe Ravana and the Golden Temple are related?#l\n#k
0.1:
I have indeed! I discovered this just recently, but the Golden Temple was created to seal Ravana. But, with tourists trampling all over the place, the seal gradually weakened to the point where Ravana awoke...

#e#b(The entire underground temple suddenly starts shaking. You can barely keep your balance.)#k

More Goblins! Quick, you have to do something!

yes.0: I recognize the work of a #o8144006# when I see it! Eliminate #b100#k of them to stop this quake! You can find them at #r#m252020500##k, in the lower western section of the temple.

no.0: I recognize the work of a #o8144006# when I see it! This quake will not stop until we do something!
